message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.65,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or approval vote fairly compares visibility, educational value, and hybrid benefits while preventing one objective from dominating without support.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Favors a full-budget inter-city tournament to increase the club's visibility and attract attention.","influence":0.33},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Favors investing the full budget in educational materials and new chessboards to improve learning conditions.","influence":0.34},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Favors splitting the budget between a smaller tournament and equipment purchases to balance visibility and instruction.","influence":0.33}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The three options represent legitimate but competing club objectives, and each has identified weaknesses. Use a ranked-choice vote after agreeing on evaluation criteria, while allowing a negotiated hybrid plan that may allocate funds by measured priorities rather than an arbitrary equal split."}
